proxy_timeout.zh: 等待 AstroPhotoFlow 服务超时。

proxy_maintenance.en: The workbench is under maintenance and cannot accept new runs.
proxy_maintenance.zh: 工作台正在维护，暂不接受新运行。

proxy_state_unknown.en: The workbench maintenance state could not be confirmed.
proxy_state_unknown.zh: 无法确认工作台维护状态。

media_interrupted.en: Viewing preparation was interrupted. Retry explicitly.
media_interrupted.zh: 查看准备被中断，请显式重试。

media_not_watched.en: High-resolution preparation was cancelled because there are no viewers.
media_not_watched.zh: 无人继续查看，已取消高清准备。

media_executor_closing.en: The preview executor is shutting down. Try again later.
media_executor_closing.zh: 预览执行器正在关闭，请稍后重试。

software_call_identity_conflict.en: Call ID already belongs to other inputs.
software_call_identity_conflict.zh: 调用 ID 已用于其他输入。

native_canvas_unconfigured.en: The native canvas address is not configured.
native_canvas_unconfigured.zh: 原生画布地址尚未配置。

export_completed_result_required.en: Select a completed Data result before exporting.
export_completed_result_required.zh: 请选择已完成的 Data 结果再导出。

native_receipt_identity_mismatch.en: The native receipt identity does not match. Continue checking the original operation.
native_receipt_identity_mismatch.zh: 原生回执身份不匹配，请继续核对原操作。

export_suggested_filename_invalid.en: Suggested filename cannot contain directory components.
export_suggested_filename_invalid.zh: 建议文件名不能包含目录部分。

export_request_identity_conflict.en: request_id already belongs to a different export.
export_request_identity_conflict.zh: request_id 已用于另一项导出。

export_not_active.en: This export is not active; inspect the existing receipt.
export_not_active.zh: 此导出已不在执行中，请查看原有回执。

export_member_outside_result.en: Selected export member is outside the completed result.
export_member_outside_result.zh: 所选导出成员不属于已完成结果。

export_absolute_destination_required.zh: 请选择本机绝对路径作为目标。

export_members_need_folder.en: Multiple members require an existing destination folder.
export_members_need_folder.zh: 导出多个成员需要已有的目标文件夹。

export_managed_destination_forbidden.en: Local exports cannot write into managed library storage.
export_managed_destination_forbidden.zh: 本机导出不能写入素材库的托管存储。

export_source_changed_after_selection.en: Complete source changed after export selection.
export_source_changed_after_selection.zh: 完整原件在选择导出后发生变化。

export_source_changed_during_conversion.en: Source changed while converting the complete image.
export_source_changed_during_conversion.zh: 完整图像在转换过程中发生变化。

export_registration_unconfirmed.en: Inspect registration_task_id; do not repeat this export or upstream processing.
export_registration_unconfirmed.zh: 请查询 registration_task_id；不要重复导出或上游处理。

export_filename_invalid.en: Export name cannot contain a directory component.
export_filename_invalid.zh: 导出名称不能包含目录部分。

export_extension_mismatch.en: Destination extension must match the selected format.
export_extension_mismatch.zh: 目标扩展名必须与所选格式一致。

export_copy_verification_failed.en: Local copy did not match the validated complete file. Inspect this failed destination before continuing.
export_copy_verification_failed.zh: 本机副本与已校验的完整文件不符，请检查失败的目标文件再继续。

science_image_plane_required.en: Only nonempty grayscale or RGB image planes are supported; channels are never silently dropped.
science_image_plane_required.zh: 仅支持非空灰度或 RGB 图像平面；不会静默丢弃通道。

science_real_pixels_required.en: Only real integer or floating pixels are supported.
science_real_pixels_required.zh: 仅支持实数整数或浮点像素。

science_tiff_series_selection_required.en: Multi-series TIFF is available as an original copy; select an image plane upstream before conversion.
science_tiff_series_selection_required.zh: 多序列 TIFF 可按原件复制；转换前请在上游明确选择图像平面。

science_tiff_axes_invalid.en: TIFF axes do not describe one grayscale/RGB plane; keep the original complete container.
science_tiff_axes_invalid.zh: TIFF 轴不表示单个灰度或 RGB 平面，请保留完整原始容器。

import_project_retry_tasks_active.en: Wait for active tasks before retrying project links.
import_project_retry_tasks_active.zh: 请等待活动任务结束后再重试项目关联。

import_project_retry_revision_required.en: Read the active project and reconcile its current revision first.
import_project_retry_revision_required.zh: 请先读取有效项目并核对当前修订。

import_request_identity_conflict.en: The request_id was already accepted with different content.
import_request_identity_conflict.zh: 该 request_id 已按不同内容受理。

import_project_inactive.en: Project must exist and be active.
import_project_inactive.zh: 项目必须存在且处于有效状态。

import_project_revision_changed.en: Project changed; read its current revision and reconcile before submitting.
import_project_revision_changed.zh: 项目已变化，请读取当前修订并核对后再提交。

import_group_outside_inspection.en: Group is not in this inspection.

import_group_members_invalid.en: Every selected member must belong to this scan and occur in only one group.
import_group_members_invalid.zh: 所选成员必须来自本次扫描，且每个成员只能属于一个组。

inspection_entry_kind_invalid.en: kind must be files, groups, excluded or issues.
inspection_entry_kind_invalid.zh: kind 必须为 files、groups、excluded 或 issues。

inspection_absolute_paths_required.zh: 检查需要本机绝对路径。

data_upstream_port_not_science.en: Upstream port is not a science output.
data_upstream_port_not_science.zh: 上游端口不是科学输出。

data_execution_identity_conflict.en: Execution ID already belongs to another Data input.
data_execution_identity_conflict.zh: 执行 ID 已用于另一项 Data 输入。

data_execution_not_completed.en: Previous execution did not complete. Inspect its record instead of replaying it.
data_execution_not_completed.zh: 上次执行尚未成功完成，请查看原记录，不要重放执行。

data_complete_member_required.en: Data requires at least one complete member.
data_complete_member_required.zh: Data 至少需要一个完整成员。

data_upstream_prompt_mismatch.en: Upstream science result must belong to this native run.
data_upstream_prompt_mismatch.zh: 上游科学结果必须属于本次原生任务。

data_image_shape_invalid.en: IMAGE member must have the declared floating dtype and nonempty grayscale/RGB shape.
data_image_shape_invalid.zh: IMAGE 成员必须使用声明的浮点类型，并具有非空灰度或 RGB 形状。

result_record_identity_mismatch.en: Checked result identity differs from its address.
result_record_identity_mismatch.zh: 已检查结果的身份与其地址不符。

result_execution_identity_conflict.en: Execution already owns different checked output facts.
result_execution_identity_conflict.zh: 该执行已拥有不同的已检查输出事实。

result_prompt_mismatch.en: Only checked outputs from this native prompt may be consumed.
result_prompt_mismatch.zh: 只能使用本次原生任务中已检查的输出。

result_output_port_invalid.en: Output port is missing or has an incompatible type.
result_output_port_invalid.zh: 输出端口不存在或类型不兼容。

result_changed_after_execution.zh: 已检查结果在执行后发生变化。

result_frozen_bytes_mismatch.en: Checked result bytes differ from the frozen output.
result_frozen_bytes_mismatch.zh: 已检查文件的字节与固定输出不符。

result_file_missing.en: The checked file is missing; an old preview cannot replace it.
result_file_missing.zh: 已检查文件缺失，不能用旧预览代替。

result_outside_execution_directory.en: Output is outside its software execution directory.
result_outside_execution_directory.zh: 输出不在所属软件执行目录内。

science_raw_decode_required.en: Decode/demosaic RAW explicitly upstream before conversion, or copy the original file.
science_raw_decode_required.zh: 转换前请在上游明确解码或去马赛克 RAW，或按原始格式复制文件。

science_encoded_layout_mismatch.en: Encoded dimensions, channels or precision do not match the request.
science_encoded_layout_mismatch.zh: 编码后的尺寸、通道或精度与请求不符。

science_encoded_pixels_mismatch.en: Encoded pixel values do not match the requested conversion.
science_encoded_pixels_mismatch.zh: 编码后的像素值与请求的转换不符。

science_float_overflow.en: Finite values overflow the selected floating precision.
science_float_overflow.zh: 有限值超出了所选浮点精度的范围。

science_fits_hdu_required.en: Choose an explicit image HDU before conversion.
science_fits_hdu_required.zh: 转换前请选择明确的图像 HDU。

science_fits_hdu_not_image.en: The selected HDU is not an image plane.
science_fits_hdu_not_image.zh: 所选 HDU 不是图像平面。

science_xisf_selection_required.en: Multi-image XISF requires explicit upstream image selection; original copying preserves the entire container.
science_xisf_selection_required.zh: 多图像 XISF 需要在上游明确选择图像；按原件复制会保留整个容器。

science_integer_overflow.en: Pixel values do not fit the selected integer range. Choose floating output or an explicit normalization/display range.
science_integer_overflow.zh: 像素值超出所选整数范围，请选择浮点输出或明确的归一化／显示范围。

science_display_channels_mismatch.en: The frozen display recipe does not match this member's grayscale/RGB channels.
science_display_channels_mismatch.zh: 固定显示配方与该成员的灰度或 RGB 通道不符。

science_normalization_nonfinite.en: Normalization contains NaN/Inf; use floating output or explicitly choose display rendering.
science_normalization_nonfinite.zh: 归一化包含 NaN 或 Inf，请使用浮点输出或明确选择显示渲染。

science_integer_rounding_required.en: Fractional values require explicit rounding (nearest, ties to even), normalization or display rendering.
science_integer_rounding_required.zh: 小数值需要明确选择舍入（最近值，平局取偶数）、归一化或显示渲染。

science_video_conversion_frame_required.en: Choose an explicit video frame before conversion.
science_video_conversion_frame_required.zh: 转换前请选择明确的视频帧。

science_raw_conversion_forbidden.en: RAW files can be copied in their original format. Decode/demosaic explicitly upstream before converting them; export never silently develops sensor data.
science_raw_conversion_forbidden.zh: RAW 可按原始格式复制；转换前请在上游明确解码或去马赛克，导出不会静默处理传感器数据。

science_conversion_unsupported.en: This complete file can be copied in its original format, but cannot be converted to an image.
science_conversion_unsupported.zh: 此完整文件可按原始格式复制，但不能转换为图像。

science_numpy_array_required.zh: 请选择明确的 NumPy 数组。

export_local_picker_busy.en: The local file picker is busy.
export_local_picker_busy.zh: 本机文件选择器正在使用。

export_local_picker_unavailable.en: The local file picker is unavailable.
export_local_picker_unavailable.zh: 本机文件选择器不可用。

inspection_source_changed.zh: 来源自检查后发生变化：{path}

bundle_development_not_ready.zh: 开发 Bundle 尚未就绪。

mcp_tool_not_found.en: The requested tool was not found.

mcp_transport_timeout.en: Reply unknown. Query the original operation ID; do not replay writes.
mcp_transport_timeout.zh: 受理结果未知。请查询原操作 ID，不要重放写入。

mcp_service_unavailable.en: Cannot reach the selected local workspace service.
mcp_service_unavailable.zh: 无法连接所选本机工作区服务。

mcp_unexpected_failure.en: Unexpected tool failure; inspect the local service logs.
mcp_unexpected_failure.zh: 工具发生未预期错误，请检查本机服务日志。

import_link_originals_not_ready.en: Only groups with all originals available are linked. Retry failed items, then explicitly retry project linking.
import_link_originals_not_ready.zh: 仅关联原件全部就绪的组；请先重试失败成员，再明确重试项目关联。

import_link_dataset_archived.en: The imported dataset is archived; restore it before retrying project linking.
import_link_dataset_archived.zh: 导入集合已归档，请恢复后再重试项目关联。

import_link_project_changed.en: Project changed after confirmation. Read it before retrying project linking.
import_link_project_changed.zh: 项目在确认后发生变化，请读取后再重试项目关联。

inspection_source_changed_reading.en: Source changed while reading its metadata.
inspection_source_changed_reading.zh: 来源在读取元数据时发生变化。

bundle_preview_failed.en: Software live preview did not complete. See the original diagnostics.
bundle_preview_failed.zh: 软件实时预览未完成，请查看原始诊断。

bundle_preview_maintenance.en: The software package is undergoing maintenance.
